brand_identity.name: Duarte's Limpezas, Desentupidora e Manutenções
brand_identity.art_direction: High-contrast architectural layout meets fluid water-like momentum. Deep ocean blues contrasting with vast, sterile white spaces. Yellow acts as the high-visibility kinetic trigger. The site must feel like an elite facility management agency, not a generic local plumber.

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-bold
scale.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-bold
scale.overline: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-primary

rules.no_defaults: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Embed Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi via Fontshare or local assets.
rules.headings: Never center headings unless explicitly in a symmetrical section like Testimonials. Left-align for editorial authority.

primary.description: Deep Blue. Used for main headings, footer, strong structural elements.

secondary.description: Medium Blue. Used for secondary active states, icons, subtle highlights.

accent.description: Warning/Action Yellow. Used EXCLUSIVELY for CTAs, prominent buttons, and kinetic accents.

grid_system.standard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-12 lg:gap-24 items-center

scroll.config: { duration: 1.2, easing: (t) => Math.min(1, 1.001 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t)), orientation: 'vertical', smoothWheel: true }

navbar.design: Fixed top, ultra-clean. Left: Logo. Center: Hidden on mobile, spaced links on desktop. Right: CTA Button (Yellow).
navbar.behavior: Glassmorphism background `bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl`. Shrinks slightly on scroll down.

hero.design: Kinetic, immersive. Full viewport height (`min-h-[90vh]`). Background is the provided video.
hero.overlay: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0B3C5D]/90 via-[#0B3C5D]/70 to-transparent absolute inset-0 z-0
hero.content: Left-aligned, massive typography. Signature on-load moment: Text lines wrapped in overflow-hidden divs, sliding up revealing 'Duarte's', 'Excelência em', 'Manutenção'.

marquee.design: Slow editorial marquee passing right below the hero or above footer.
marquee.content: • LÍDERES EM MANUTENÇÃO • ATENDIMENTO 24H • PARANAVAÍ E REGIÃO • HIDROJATEAMENTO •
marquee.style: bg-primary text-white py-4 text-sm font-semibold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap

services_section.layout: Grid (8 cards). 4 cols desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile.
services_section.card_design: Clean white cards, generous padding (`p-8`). Top: Lucide icon in a light blue circle (`bg-blue-50 text-secondary`). Middle: H4 Title + short description. Bottom: WhatsApp link with arrow.

differentials.layout: Bento Grid or Masonry for 10 items.
differentials.design: Mix of small square cards (icon + title) and horizontal cards. Use soft background `#F8F9FA` for the section. Cards are pure white.
differentials.icons: Use distinct, thin Lucide icons. Stroke width 1.5.

how_it_works.design: A solid line `border-l-2 border-slate-200` running down the left. Step markers are white circles that fill with `#FFC107` (Framer Motion scroll trigger).
how_it_works.typography: Steps should look like chapters. '01', '02' in large, light typography (`text-primary/20 text-6xl font-bold font-heading`).

gallery.design: Premium masonry or CSS grid layout. Images have `overflow-hidden` wrappers with subtle `scale` on hover. Use lightbox for full view.
gallery.treatment: Images should have a very subtle contrast boost via CSS (`contrast-105 saturate-105`) to look highly professional.

testimonials.design: Horizontal scroll or standard grid of 3 premium cards. 5-star icons in `#FFC107`. Text `text-lg text-slate-700 italic`.

faq.design: Accordion style (Shadcn style or custom framer-motion). Clean lines `border-b border-slate-200`. No boxes, just elegant typography expanding smoothly.

footer.design: Massive, dark, architectural footer. `bg-primary text-white`. Large typography CTA 'Pronto para resolver seu problema?'.
footer.map: Embed Paranavaí map in a rounded overflow-hidden container with grayscale/blue filter if possible, or clean standard map.

floating_elements.whatsapp: Fixed bottom right. `z-50`. Standard WA Green (`#25D366`) for conversion recognition, but premium pill shape with Lucide Icon and 'Orçamento Rápido' text on desktop. Pulse animation.

universal_guidelines.testing: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='btn-whatsapp-hero'`).
universal_guidelines.anti_ai_slop: DO NOT use generic centered text with basic gradients. DO NOT use generic AI emojis. Create depth with real CSS shadows and structural padding. Never apply `transition: all`. Use `.js` extension for components. Maintain high contrast text.
